note: Each default change on this channel, one at a time (multi-channel step 4).

changes.from: countries drawn, painted or recoloured on their word, the border in plain ink
changes.to: a bright line with a glowing head runs round the border and closes on the word that names it, then stays lit; the country takes a colour and its uncut 3:2 flag sits inside it as big as fits (flat/map.tsx trace and flag; flat/flags.tsx, about 60 flags; director.md)
